{{Quote|I hope you're not hungry. They haven't given us any food or water since they locked us up.|A jaded pilot, held prisoner on the Street of Glory|<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game">[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game|''Star Wars: Invasion of Theed'' Adventure Game]]</ref>}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the governing body of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], passed [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|legislation]] calling for the taxation of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] to outlying [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. A trade dispute soon developed between the megacorperation, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the Republic, resulting in the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] shortly thereafter.<ref name="E1TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> While [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Naboo was occupied, several students from Naboo's [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]] joined the [[Naboo Underground]], but were eventually captured by the Trade Federation occupying forces.

{{RPG}}
The students were held in [[Prison Compound 32]], a Trade Federation prison camp that was built from portable energy walls within the city of Theed. The group was imprisoned with [[Ruto Graven]], who was [[Assistant Minister of Internal Affairs]] for [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]; [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Boraso]], an [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guard]]; and the [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Ela Sivel]]. Boraso, who had been wounded in battle, had managed to hide a set of security tools in his belt when he was captured, but did not have the personal expertise to use the tools.

While talking with the other prisoners, one of the students, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], felt a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|distubance]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Padawan traced the feeling to a [[Darth Maul/Legends|figure in black robes]] walking past the prison with a pair of [[Viceroy/Legends|high ranking]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]]. The robed figure briefly scrutinized the Padawan, before continuing.

Eventually, the students attempted to escape. Most of the students attempted to distract the pair of [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]] guarding the energy gate while another student set about disabling the gate's console. The students managed to disable the gate and grab their weapons and gear, stored in a crate just outside the prison entrance.

After defeating the immediate guards, the students held off a squad of four [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s while their cellmates escaped.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
This article is based on '''Adventure 3A: Escape''', a pre-packaged adventure included in the ''[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game]]'', designed for streamlined play. The game set includes eight playable playable characters, although the adventures are designed for four. Adventure 3A is designed to be used if the players are defeated during another mission. The details of the adventure recommend replacing Ruto Graven and Ela Sivel with [[Lialla Tane]]'s mother and [[Kyu Tane|father]] if the players have not successfully completed '''[[Street of Glory Prison Break|Adventure 3: Rescue]]''' has not been successfully completed.
